title: The susi-command refusal must match renamed binaries
goal: The worker ran /out/roadmap/susi12.exe workflow finish and the refusal only matched a binary literally named susi or susi.exe, so a renamed harness binary got through and blocked the turn while it pushed. Match any command-position binary whose file stem is susi or susi followed by a version/lab suffix, with tests for susi12.exe and for cargo commands that mention susi.
